CE.note: Absolute limits are stress limits, not targets. R12 now pulls CE up from BQ25185 SYS, separating CE from the abnormal USB-voltage domain. SYS and CE must still be checked over attach/detach, dead-pack startup and transients.

engineering_bench_targets.scope: Proposed 100mV measurement margin relative to table limits; not a new manufacturer specification.

required_observations: Scope CE directly at U3 pin4 relative to device ground
Record both steady state and peak transients
Measure charger current independently; CE alone does not demonstrate actual charging has stopped
Record SYS and Q4 leakage loading; confirm CE never exceeds pin stress limits
Verify SYS establishes a valid CE-high inhibit during dead-pack USB startup before charging can begin
Reconcile the 1.8V logic-table test condition with the actual SYS pull-up domain before release
